tool.name: IMAGINE-X subhkl Rainbow Zones Visualizer
tool.command:
mkdir -p out ; mv "$peaks_h5" "$peaks_h5.element_identifier" ;
python -m subhkl.io.parser rainbow-visualize "$peaks_h5.element_identifier" --output-html out/rainbow_zones.html --mode $default_mode --max-zone-index $max_zone_index --zone-tolerance-deg $zone_tolerance_deg #if $instrument != "AUTO": --instrument $instrument #end if

param.name: peaks_h5
param.label: Indexed or Found Peaks HDF5 (indexer.h5 / solve.h5 / finder.h5)

param.name: default_mode
param.label: Default Visual Mode
param.option: Rainbow Arcade Mode (1987 Taito Rainbow Islands + 80s Parallax)

tool.help: Generates the interactive **Rainbow Zones** Laue zone diagnostic report (featuring synchronized Stereographic Wulff Net + Unrolled Detector Conics, Lattice Ladder rung progression, 80s resolution parallax, and one-click toggle between *Rainbow Arcade Mode* and *Pro View*).
